Description: The referee blows for the end of today's match.
Sebastien Bassong (Norwich) protests to the referee and receives a yellow card.
It will be a corner kick for Norwich. Robert Snodgrass (Norwich) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ricky van Wolfswinkel walks off the pitch to be replaced by Josh Murphy (Norwich).
The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
Ricky van Wolfswinkel (Norwich) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his effort on goal goes well wide of the right post. A really poor shot. That will be a goal kick.
Robert Snodgrass (Norwich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

Robert Snodgrass (Norwich) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Norwich.
Bradley Johnson (Norwich) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes wide of the right post. It will be a goal kick.
Bradley Johnson (Norwich) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post. The play will restart with a goal kick.

Nathan Redmond (Norwich) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Tim Howard makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom left corner.
The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Norwich. The corner from Robert Snodgrass (Norwich) is cleared away by the defence.
Here comes a substitution. Steven Pienaar (Everton) has had enough and is replaced by Steven Naismith (Everton).
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Leon Osman leaves the pitch and Johnny Heitinga (Everton) comes on.

Seamus Coleman (Everton) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar. The ball crosses the byline and it's going to be a goal kick.
Kevin Mirallas (Everton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
Leighton Baines (Everton) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
A pass into the penalty area from Leighton Baines (Everton) is intercepted by the defence. Norwich will take a corner kick.
Here comes a substitution. Nathan Redmond (Norwich) is brought on as a substitute for Javier Garrido.
Romelu Lukaku (Everton) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
Ryan Bennett (Norwich) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
CHANCE! Romelu Lukaku (Everton) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a low shot to the bottom left corner, but John Ruddy produces an excellent save.

2 - 0
Kevin Mirallas (Everton) takes the free kick and beats the goalkeeper with a shot which goes inside the left post. Simply stunning!
Ryan Bennett (Norwich) tripped an opposition player and a free kick is given. Everton win a free kick.

Ricky van Wolfswinkel (Norwich) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar. A short break for the players as the play will restart with a goal kick.
Kevin Mirallas (Everton) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. A goal kick will follow.
Leighton Baines (Everton) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of bounds. Everton win a corner kick.
James McCarthy (Everton) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
Leighton Baines (Everton) takes a short corner kick.
Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Kevin Mirallas (Everton). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
Seamus Coleman (Everton) gives away a free kick for tripping his opponent. Even though he is protesting that first he hit the ball, the referee is sure about his call. Norwich with a free kick.
Everton are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
Seamus Coleman (Everton) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
What a miskick by Phil Jagielka (Everton). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands. It's a goal kick.
Kevin Friend blows his whistle and the second half starts.
The match has reached half-time.
John Ruddy leaps to intercept the corner kick from Kevin Mirallas (Everton).
Leon Osman (Everton) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar. The referee points to the corner flag and Everton will take a corner.
John Stones (Everton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
The resulting corner from Kevin Mirallas (Everton) is cleared by the defence.
Kevin Mirallas (Everton) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Now Everton with a corner.
Great teamplay by Everton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

Romelu Lukaku (Everton) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Norwich win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
Seamus Coleman (Everton) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar. The ball is out of play. Goal kick.
Everton have a corner. A dangerous looking corner kick from Leighton Baines (Everton) is cleared to safety by the defence.
Robert Snodgrass (Norwich) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Everton have a free kick.
Everton force a corner. They send men into the box. Kevin Mirallas (Everton) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
Kevin Mirallas (Everton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

Gareth Barry (Everton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area. The opposition's defence is alert, and one of the defenders clears the ball away. The referee signals for a corner kick, Everton are awarded.
There's an opportunity for Robert Snodgrass (Norwich) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

A neat pass is well received by Ricky van Wolfswinkel (Norwich), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot. Norwich earn a corner.
Norwich have been awarded a corner kick. The corner kick from Robert Snodgrass (Norwich) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

1 - 0
Goal! Romelu Lukaku tees up Gareth Barry (Everton) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
The resulting corner from Leighton Baines (Everton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
Kevin Mirallas (Everton) fires a powerful shot which is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
The ball goes out of play. Everton are awarded a corner kick. Leighton Baines (Everton) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
The Everton players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
Steven Pienaar (Everton) makes a slide tackle, but referee Kevin Friend blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Norwich.
Romelu Lukaku (Everton) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
Gary Hooper (Norwich) is picked up by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't receive the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without problems. What a pity.
Romelu Lukaku (Everton) wasted a good opportunity as he sends an inaccurate final pass into the box, which is blocked by the opponent's defence. The assistant referee signals a throw-in for Everton.
Romelu Lukaku (Everton) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
Seamus Coleman (Everton) attempts to send a cross in order to find one of his teammates. The opposition's defence averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
Everton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

Seamus Coleman (Everton) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went low towards the middle of the target, but John Ruddy was alert and the score remained the same.
The ball is passed from one Everton player to another, and the game isn't very exciting. Nothing lasts forever, though. They make a mistake, and possession is taken by the opponent.

A big opportunity is wasted by Bradley Johnson (Norwich), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Tim Howard pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
